Let $x$ be the total number of jellyfish in the tank.

A fifth of the jellyfish are large, so the number of large jellyfish is $\frac{1}{5}x$.
A third of the large jellyfish change color from green to blue under UV light. So the number of large jellyfish that change color is $\frac{1}{3} \times \frac{1}{5}x = \frac{1}{15}x$.
